narr: A brief period of heavy rainfall caused mud and rocks to cover Highway 125, as anywhere from 0.25 to 0.50 inches of rain fell in 30 minutes. The highway was closed between Trail Creek and Coral Cabin Creek Road (FR 112). There was some road damage with a large area of mud and rocks covering the roadway. Two bulldozers were brought out to remove the debris.
ev: Highway 125 was closed when a brief burst of rain caused a mudslide between Trail Creek and Forest Road 112.
lsr: HIGHWAY 125 CLOSED BETWEEN TRAIL CREEK AND FS ROAD 112 DUE TO A DEBRIS FLOW/FLASH FLOOD.
